description.en: The ID of the image repository.

description.zh:
触发器名称

非必选参数，TriggerName与TriggerUrl参数二选一
description.en:
The name of the trigger.

You can specify the TriggerName or TriggerUrl parameter. The TriggerName parameter is optional.

description.zh: 触发触发器的镜像版本
description.en: The image tag based on which the trigger is set.

description.zh:
触发类型，取值：

- `ALL`：全部触发

- `TAG_LISTTAG`：触发

- `TAG_REG_EXP`：表达式触发
description.en:
The type of the trigger. Valid values:

*   `ALL`: a trigger that supports both tags and regular expressions.
*   `TAG_LISTTAG`: a tag-based trigger.
*   `TAG_REG_EXP`: a regular expression-based trigger.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr update-repo-trigger --instance-id cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000 --repo-id crr-tquyps22md8p0000 --trigger-name test_trigger --trigger-url https://www.test.com --trigger-type ALL --trigger-tag master --trigger-id crw-k7bdx4kt52ty0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr UpdateRepoTrigger --region cn-hangzhou --TriggerUrl 'https://www.test.com' --TriggerType ALL --TriggerName test_trigger --InstanceId 'cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000' --TriggerTag master --TriggerId 'crw-k7bdx4kt52ty0000' --RepoId 'crr-tquyps22md8p0000'
